diff_shrink_note: run-differential shrink fitted by log loss on completed games; below 1.0 means the raw predictor separated clubs further than the results did, and the fair total is untouched by it
prob_calibration_note: Platt p' = sigmoid(a*logit(p) + b) on the moneyline only, docs/diamond-betting.md section 11b; served null until both gate arms pass, and the fitted pair is expected near identity because diff_shrink already absorbs the response scale in-sample
run_dispersion_note: NB2 run dispersion, var = lam + alpha*lam^2, by conditional MLE on both scoring sides given the model's own lambda; Poisson (alpha 0) underdisperses real run scoring by a measured var/mean of 2.34 per side and 2.37 on the margin. Served only because the pre-registered four-criterion gate in docs/diamond-betting.md section 11 passed on a held-out half; `run_dispersion` in betting_model_eval.json carries it
home_field_note: the runs regression recovers almost no home field because a home team leading after the top of the ninth never bats; the adjustment restores the observed home win rate as a run differential, leaving the fair total unchanged
source_note: fit on completed games read out of .cache/game_feeds, offline; team inputs are season-to-date leaderboards, so this fit is IN-SAMPLE and cannot validate the model
